notes: The trenchcoat. MILESTONES lists the coat as an open reference gap, so this is a decision, not a reading: a desaturated teal from the master palette's cool half (sky #3FA9F5 / sea turquoise #2FD5C8) rather than a tan. A tan coat on a tan box loses the second raccoon entirely at silhouette distance, and the cool mass is also what keeps a car-filled frame off the palette gate's one-hue failure mode. Brush overlay reduced 0.6 -> 0.18: the painterly direction is abandoned (ART_BIBLE 1) and this was still running at full strength, which is the camouflage mottle on terrain. Brush disabled (0.18 -> 0). At brushScale 0.44 m on a head-sized object the pattern repeats once or twice across the whole surface, which reads as speckle rather than texture — and the painterly direction is abandoned (ART_BIBLE 1).
